itf-publications.title: ITF Global Tennis Report editions and national reports

atp-2000-02-21.title: ATP singles ranking archive, 21 February 2000
atp-2000-02-21.limitations: Rankings are outcomes, not direct measurements of popularity, access, coaching or elite support.

itf-2019-cze.title: ITF Global Tennis Report 2019 — Czech Republic participation
itf-2019-cze.scope: Published national participation, clubs and coaches, all sexes. Report label 23 April 2019.
itf-2019-cze.limitations: Edition/report year is not proof of a common observation date for every value. Not men-only, not a historical annual series. Coach count does not measure coaching quality.

itf-2019-deu.title: ITF Global Tennis Report 2019 — Germany participation
itf-2019-deu.scope: Published national participation, clubs and coaches, all sexes. Report label 23 April 2019.
itf-2019-deu.limitations: Edition/report year is not proof of a common observation date for every value. Not men-only, not a historical annual series. Coach count does not measure coaching quality.

davis-cup-previous-champions.title: Davis Cup — Previous Champions
davis-cup-previous-champions.scope: Official year-by-year men's Davis Cup champions/finalists and honour-roll inheritance.
davis-cup-previous-champions.limitations: Elite national-team outcomes only. They do not directly measure popularity, access, development quality or federation support. Czechoslovak and West German predecessor results require explicit territorial interpretation.

dtb-membership-history.title: Deutscher Tennis Bund — Mitgliederentwicklung seit 1948
dtb-membership-history.scope: Official DTB annual youth/adult/total membership series through 2024; selected total-membership checkpoints normalized here.
dtb-membership-history.limitations: Federation membership is not all tennis participation. Before reunification the DTB series covers West Germany and therefore undercovers the territory of current Germany. The source states figures are without guarantee.

dtb-overview-current.title: Deutscher Tennis Bund — Verband overview
dtb-overview-current.scope: Current federation scale and 1902 institutional foundation context.
dtb-overview-current.limitations: Current member/club counts are rounded. Federation age is tradition context, not a direct quality score.

dtb-federal-training-centres.title: Deutscher Tennis Bund — Bundesstützpunkte
dtb-federal-training-centres.scope: Current four federal high-performance centres and integrated athlete-support services.
dtb-federal-training-centres.limitations: Current development/support infrastructure cannot be backcast unchanged across the historical series and is not itself an outcome measure.

cts-youth-centres-2025.title: Český tenisový svaz — Podpora talentované mládeže – střediska
